_comment: The quest catalogue, flattened out of the client dump. See tools/extract_quests.py.
Text is a translation key, never a string: the Studio reads the three languages
from the client itself, so a name written here would pin one language into data.
quests.givers  [[npcId, mapId], ...]  who hands the quest out, and where.
steps.dialog   the NPC line that hands the step over, absent when there is none.
objectives.params  parameter0..4 with the trailing zeroes cut. What they mean
depends on the type: for the types that name an NPC it is the
npcId, and that holds for 7.806 of 7.844 of them.
Every default value is dropped, so a missing key means zero, -1 or empty.
